purpose: Identity of every sealed benchmark (owner 2026-10-23 19:45: identity and the sealed guard by project id + sha256, never by file name; hashes only in the repository, never the files). Read by tools/v30_gate_b_v2.py guard_inputs / guard_projects. A SEALED_FILE is refused by its sha256 whatever its name (a renamed copy too); its names are refused as well (the older name guard, engine/reference_mapping.py SEALED, kept). A SEALED_PROJECT refuses every input whose project id is that id (a sealed test villa before its one use). An entry whose sha256 is null is NOT recorded in the repository: it is guarded by name only until the owner records its sha256 here (a new entry or a corrected one is a reviewed commit; nothing here is ever removed).
